display_name: D92 GroupBarrierJoint：解析注册与小适配器联合学习
description: 实际 Margin B 的旧类函数保留；新类专用解析 Ridge、逐旧点/逐新类概率障碍 gate 与继承小适配器联合。固定算法的 support OOF/oneshot proxy 诊断，不是 query 性能验收；不利用历史目标分数调参。
input_identity_source: Fixed source-only cache/capsule/model/split metadata; no scored output, adapted state or index supplied to fitting
notes: Source-only implementation configuration, not registration/launch evidence.
Existing VALIDATED_ONCE support cache reused; only literal selected support parents reach fit or scoring.
Old inner-train teacher and final actual full-path B have distinct scopes; inner held is supervised adaptation, not independent validation.
Ground A packet references are source metadata only. No old method result/fit trace is reused.
Gate and new Ridge measured counters are separate from B counters; no QP C certificate or old analysis claim.
Max Newton/line-search iterations and owned factor bytes are technical resource limits, not a process RSS or convergence guarantee.
Frozen ground Phase1 source-only scratch final200 lineage and existing raw support-cache identities reused; no checkpoint reload or encoder fine-tuning.
C inherits actual same-path B; inner old prior is separately refitted only on old inner-train with frozen actual U_B; inner-held is optimization support, not independent validation.
Gate barrier zeta=N*1e-4/(m_old*q_new) is theory-derived fixed objective approximation; finite barrier is an independently named method.
Gate H+Cholesky guard is scoped to those factor buffers, not total C memory or device RSS; unknown costs remain N/A.
Support diagnostic completion does not complete the user goal or establish query performance.

metrics_plan.A: native frozen Ground packet; current paired old-held physical IDs only; N/A when absent
metrics_plan.B: actual old-support Margin B for this path
metrics_plan.C: same actual B inherited by new-only Ridge plus Bernoulli gate
metrics_plan.k1: no independent held; all A/B/C held accuracies N/A
metrics_plan.new0: C is the same actual B object; new accuracy/H/gap N/A
metrics_plan.aggregation: physical OOF rows pooled inside each parent; proxy anchors averaged inside each parent; then equal parent averages

post_diagnostic_test_plan.fresh_independent_validation: Deferred by explicit user request; reused benchmark is not a fresh confirmation
